text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You're working hard, Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We can't just take this loss lying 
down! I'm going to take back the title of 
strongest and fastest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Besides, Ryoko-san isn't my only rival!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's true, isn't it—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Character appeal really is 
crucial after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san's comments got this much 
space in the paper."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, the cheetah comment~! That was so 
funny! Though I have no idea what it 
meant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To become an unforgettable Umamusume... 
There is so much to learn from you, Dantsu 
Light-O.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she certainly has personality, but 
her running made a much bigger impression 
on me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It was like a flash of light. A single, 
fleeting glimmer that burned right into my 
vision.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When I close my eyes, that light is still 
burned into the back of my eyelids.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That was so cool~! Curren wants to run 
like that too, squeezing everyone's hearts 
in an instant♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan also wants to stay in everyone's 
hearts forever like that."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Then let's run together with Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I received quite an unusual invitation.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, even Curren feels like running 
sometimes! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great. Running alongside the cute 
Curren Chan... We'll definitely be the 
center of attention~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan will do her best too. Ma-chan's 
legs are itching to run, you see."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Ma-chan watches videos of Right 
O-chan in the dorm room all the time. She 
seems really curious about her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course you'd be curious about it. If 
you're a sprinter—no, an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What about you, Flight-san?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Me? As for me—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll run! Because I get to run 
with Bakushin O-chan again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well then...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is spreading way more than I 
expected.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It was truly intense. A run at top speed 
that surpassed the limits of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Faster than top speed, faster still— The 
thirst of pure instinct is irresistible.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
And that thirst will be passed on to the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's far too early to talk about the 
future. From here on out, our horizons 
will expand more and more.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Crossing the sea—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: An overseas campaign?

Overseas, there are many straight-course 
races. I suggested that an overseas 
expedition could be considered as Calstone 
Light O's next step.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I do! I get to race against the fastest 
Umamusume from overseas, right?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: On the straight course!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want to go. I do! I really want to go! I 
absolutely want to go!
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll look into it.

text_block_list.text:
Overseas racetracks have drastically 
different conditions, such as the turf. I 
must formulate a new training plan so she 
can perform at her best even abroad.
choice_data_list: Looks like things are gonna get busy!
Looks like things are going to get busy!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Are you planning to buy that?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's very cute. It feels nice to the 
touch, too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Plushies shouldn't be necessary for an 
overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I want one! Kitties are cute. They're 
fluffy. They're healing. I want one.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Geez... Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, if it isn't Believe-san. Perfect 
timing—could you tell her too?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san is hopeless! We came 
shopping for the overseas tour, but she 
keeps trying to buy completely unrelated 
things."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think it's fine, isn't it? If Right O 
thinks it's necessary.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I know, but! If I leave it alone, my 
luggage will end up being nothing but cat 
merchandise!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Durandal. She knows me very 
well.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Look, just as I thought! We need to pick 
out the essentials other than cats first!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This is great. If I ever feel like dancing 
over there, I'll have my Trainer wave it 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There's no need. You dance even without 
music, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's for communicating when words fail. 
And you can kill some time with it too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It's far too big. At least use an 
inflatable one.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"As a token of our new friendship. 
Japanese Kanji! Plus, it'll keep you 
cool."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"That's...! Well... I suppose you're 
right. Very well, then."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Um... This is an expedition, right? Not a 
vacation trip, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, where are you going?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Who knows?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

I had just arrived at the shopping mall. 
Hearing a lively commotion, I looked over 
to see Calstone Light O and the others.
choice_data_list:
Hey, it's lively in here. Are you all out 
shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I came to shop for Light O-san's 
overseas trip, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The thing is, she doesn't seem to know 
the destination. Where will the away race 
be held?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's... not decided yet? Huh? We're still 
going on the overseas tour, right?

We talked about considering an overseas 
campaign, but nothing concrete has been 
decided yet. In fact, we only just talked 
about the expedition yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It seems Daitaku Helios got a little ahead 
of herself...
choice_data_list:
I came to look for books to help figure 
out an expedition destination.

I came to look for books to help decide on 
an expedition destination.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then let's go—to the 
bookstore!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh! Daitaku-san!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The UK, France, Australia... There are so 
many different places.
choice_data_list:
First, let's start with a course that 
suits you.

First, let's start with a course that 
suits you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Is it really that different?
choice_data_list:
It should feel quite different when you 
run in them.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then we'll need a countermeasure. I 
don't really get complicated things, so 
I'll leave it to you!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I think you'll understand better 
by actually running. Shall we go check out 
the course?”

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll make the arrangements right away—! 
...Wait, we haven't decided on a 
destination yet.

Judging by how excited she was while 
shopping, she seems really looking forward 
to the overseas expedition.

I should decide on our travel destination 
as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's from Mom.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
She said she's arrived at the cafe 
downstairs. Her father is with her too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let us head over, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"When I told my parents about going 
abroad, they said they wanted to talk 
about the details, so I called them over."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When I told them my Trainer was here too, 
they said they wanted you to come along.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"They said they want specific details 
regarding the expedition schedule and 
accommodations."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
She said we should have a thorough talk 
about my future as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Come, let's get going. Father and Mother 
are waiting for us.
choice_data_list:
Fast, fast, fast! At least let me prepare 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, fast is always the best no matter 
what!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Let's keep breaking our top speed record!

Calstone Light O is always fast. Faster 
than you could ever imagine.

I want to keep up with her speed, so that 
I don't get thrown off by it.

She will surely continue to show us. That 
heart-pounding speed—
